test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In March 2025, the Indian Parliament passed the Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2025. Which of the following Acts was specifically repealed by this legislation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Foreigners Act, 1946**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2025, was enacted to modernize and consolidate laws governing **immigration, foreigners, and their regulation in India**.
 
• The legislation specifically repealed **The Foreigners Act, 1946**, which had been the primary legal framework governing the entry, stay, and deportation of foreigners in India for decades.
 
• The Foreigners Act, 1946, was considered outdated and inadequate to address the complexities of contemporary **immigration and border security challenges**.
 
• The new bill aims to establish a more comprehensive and technology-driven approach to **managing immigration and foreigner-related matters**.
 
• The bill introduces provisions for **e-governance, better monitoring of foreign nationals, and streamlined deportation processes**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Foreigners Act, 1946:**

 
 
• It was enacted by the British Government to regulate the entry, presence, and departure of foreigners in India.
 
• The Act empowered the government to declare any foreign national as an illegal immigrant and deport them.
 
• The Act also provided for powers to arrest, detain, or restrict the movement of foreigners under certain circumstances.
 
 
 
• **Immigration Challenges in India:**
 
 
• India faces significant immigration challenges, including **illegal migration across porous borders** with neighboring countries like Bangladesh and Myanmar.
 
• The lack of a modern and unified immigration framework has hindered efficient regulation and monitoring of foreign nationals.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of the Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2025:**
 
 
• Introduces a centralized database for monitoring the entry and exit of foreign nationals.
 
• Enhances penalties for violation of immigration laws.
 
• Establishes dedicated immigration courts to expedite the resolution of disputes and deportation cases.
 
 
 
• **Related Legislation:**
 
 
• The Emigration Act, 1983, governs the emigration of Indian nationals for overseas employment and remains unaffected by the new bill.
 
• The Citizenship Act, 1955, deals with the acquisition and termination of Indian citizenship and is also separate from the Immigration and Foreigners Bill.
